entities.summary: Dietrich Wilhelm Bernhard von Jagow was a German naval officer, politician, SA-Obergruppenführer and diplomat. He served as the German ambassador to Hungary from 1941 to 1944, and committed suicide just before the end of the Second World War in Europe.
